In Switzerland, the universal emergency number for all services — including police, fire, and air rescue — is:

**112**

This number works across Switzerland and is the quickest way to reach emergency services. When you call, the operator will assess the situation and dispatch the most appropriate response — which, if a helicopter (such as a Rega rescue helicopter) is faster or more suitable, will be arranged accordingly.

Additionally, Rega (the Swiss Air-Rescue Guard) can also be contacted directly at **1414** — but calling 112 first is the standard procedure, as it ensures immediate coordination of all available rescue resources.
